title: Reduce sufficient uniform-rank exponent 18.28× with net taxes and log moments
body:
My native profile in #4453 required a sufficient uniform rank of `2^2299850000000`. This reusable compiler reduces it to **`2^125790000000`**, an **18.2832× reduction in the exponent**, while retaining conditional **κ = 0.00300120**. Tensor power falls from 675 to 260. At the unchanged tested saving, the new bounds already reduce the exponent by 12.146×; balancing the certified slack gives the headline result.

The new package is `research/net-tax-rank-compiler/`. It proves net splitting/completion tax bounds, a normalized logarithmic majorant, the separated compiler's exact paid exit law, and a concentration/Bell-polynomial certificate using paid logarithmic moments. A generic exact checker accepts future paid/target profiles and witnesses without emitting the product histogram. A second p7 profile reproduces the method's applicability beyond one invoice.

Verification passes: seven exact benchmark certificates, nine mathematical tests, nine invalid-witness controls, six literal pinned-flow comparisons, registered metadata/pins, committed-byte preflight, and a Git-free isolated/optimized export replay. Separate Sol 6.1 xhigh agents audited the mathematics and recovered Bell coefficients through iid convolution and Newton differences. These are author-side AI checks, not formal or independent human acceptance. The optional ancestry preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout; exact bytes and portable replay were checked separately.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/net-tax-rank-compiler
python3.12 -I -O -B research/net-tax-rank-compiler/verify.py
```

This branch is stacked on #4453 at `de6869e2e4d9c6f630bac5de4a919d99a2cb884b`. New work is confined to the package above; inherited #4440/#4441/#4453 research files retain their predecessor status. Shared documentation matches canonical main. See the source pins and VALIDATION.md. The newer pending #4470/#4479 construction is acknowledged; this PR makes no strongest-κ or cross-profile rank claim.

Native and outer producer receipts are inherited rather than rerun. The new uniform saving supplies the retained outer point by monotonicity. All-column correctness, whole-job adapters, owned erasure, finite native closure, analytic, physical tape, stock, precision, prime-avoidance and exact-recovery premises remain. No new κ, selected-frontier update, materialized word size or runtime speedup is claimed.

Credit Jacob Alan Sussman's finite integer compiler, Cinna Davis's thinning and fresh-helper work, my κ=.0023/native/controller/higher-moment/logarithmic contributions, and the full retained predecessor lineage. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Open next questions include exact raw log moments, a changed native paid profile for κ, and productive-width/physical-constant bounds.


### Hosted CI status

The new net-tax package and six inherited scientific replays passed at head `896b877eae0b297c6da1ee78c6dd6a94a9c5868f`. After excluding inherited shared-documentation edits, run [39701477284](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39701477284) stops in onboarding planning: four existing current-status/navigation tests fail. The same four failures reproduce from canonical main `2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db` using its unchanged test, selected record and documentation. The current head scientific matrix is therefore skipped; this is not an all-green hosted CI claim. No historical frozen source or verifier was changed to bypass those checks.
